topic: How we work: building a website step by step
caption:
How does a website actually get built? Here's how we approach it, step by step. 🛠️

1️⃣ Discover: start with the goal (leads, bookings or sales)
2️⃣ Design: wireframes, then visual design you review first
3️⃣ Build: modern stacks like Next.js and React, mobile-first
4️⃣ Launch & measure: speed, SEO basics and analytics, then improve

No mystery, no surprises. Swipe through for each step. →

Is your website holding your business back? DM us WEBSITE and tell us what it needs to do.

Share this with someone planning a new site. 🔁

slides.title: Discover
slides.body: We start with your goal: leads, bookings or sales. Then map the pages and content that get you there.

slides.title: Design
slides.body: Wireframes first, then visual design. You review the layout before the build starts.

slides.title: Build
slides.body: Modern stacks like Next.js and React, mobile-first and tested on real devices as we go.

slides.title: Launch & measure
slides.body: Speed checks, SEO basics and analytics before go-live. Then we use the data to improve.
